subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar, em textos versificados, efeitos de sentido decorrentes do uso de recursos rítmicos e sonoros e de metáforas.

components.description_pt: Identificar dispositivos rítmicos e sonoros em textos versificados
components.description_en: Identify rhythmic and sound devices in versified texts
components.cc_component_description: Identify sound devices such as alliteration and rhyme in a story, poem, or song

components.description_pt: Interpretar efeitos de sentido produzidos por dispositivos rítmicos e sonoros em poemas
components.description_en: Interpret meaning effects produced by rhythmic and sound devices in poems
components.cc_component_description: Identify structural elements of poems such as verse, rhythm, and meter

components.description_pt: Identificar comparações e metáforas dentro de um texto dado
components.description_en: Identify similes and metaphors within a given text
components.cc_component_description: Identify similes and metaphors within a given text

components.description_pt: Interpretar efeitos de sentido resultantes do uso de metáforas em poemas
components.description_en: Interpret meaning effects arising from the use of metaphors in poems
components.cc_component_description: Explain how figurative language such as similes and metaphors contributes to meaning in context

cc_matches.description: Explain the meaning of simple similes and metaphors (e.g., as pretty as a picture) in context.
Interpret figurative language, including similes and metaphors, in context.
Describe how words and phrases (e.g., regular beats, alliteration, rhymes, repeated lines) supply rhythm and meaning in a story, poem, or song.

Explain major differences between poems, drama, and prose, and refer to the structural elements of poems (e.g., verse, rhythm, meter) and drama (e.g., casts of characters, settings, descriptions, dialogue, stage directions) when writing or speaking about a text.
